_meta.note: MACHINE-TRANSLATED, NOT REVIEWED BY A HUMAN SPEAKER. An AI review pass (2026-08-16) corrected the defects listed in the PR and found no others, but it is the same class of tool that produced the catalogue and is NOT a substitute for native-speaker sign-off. Approved by the project owner (2026-08-16) on that basis. Note also that `uk` is a UI locale only: it is NOT in the frozen consent language list (CRR §32), so GDPR consent notices for these users still render in German until SPEC-CONSENT-001 is amended. See backend/src/lib/locales.ts.
